definition: To propel oneself through water by bodily movements.
exampleSentence: He can swim across the river easily.

definition: To operate the direction and speed of a motor vehicle.
exampleSentence: Can you drive a manual car?

definition: To utter words or communicate in a specified language.
exampleSentence: She can speak three languages fluently.

definition: To prepare food by heating it.
exampleSentence: My father can cook delicious pasta.

definition: To engage in activity for enjoyment or perform music.
exampleSentence: They can play chess very well.

definition: To make musical sounds with the voice.
exampleSentence: She can sing English songs very beautifully.
They can dance traditional dances together.
He can run five kilometers without stopping.

definition: To apply paint to a surface or produce a picture.
exampleSentence: Can you paint a picture of our house?

definition: To push oneself off a surface into the air.
exampleSentence: The dog can jump over the low garden fence.
